svg.title: HC-SR04 Ultrasonic Sensor
svg.text: Direct module wiring · unused breadboard omitted

svg.font-family: Inter, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Arduino Uno R3
svg.desc: Component side of an Arduino Uno R3 at true scale, 2.7 × 2.1 in, USB socket and barrel jack on the left: the digital header along the top edge and the power and analog headers along the bottom edge, each socket named in rotated silkscreen type, the ATmega328P DIP-28 in the lower right.

svg.font-family: Inter, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor
svg.desc: Front of an HC-SR04 ultrasonic distance sensor at true scale, 45 × 20 mm: a blue board with two silver transducers marked T and R, a crystal between them, and four pins, Vcc, Trig, Echo and Gnd, sticking out of the lower edge.
